source_text: Plaga leprae in cute — vitium in conversatione patens. Sacerdos videt et diiudicat. Non omnis tumor lepra.
pass_a_gloss: Plague of-leprosy on skin — vice in conduct open. Priest sees and judges. Not every swelling leprosy.
pass_b_english: A [[leprous plague on the skin >> Bible:Leviticus 13:2]] — vice open in conduct. The priest sees and judges. Not every swelling is leprosy.
